method.success: HTTP 200 + protocol terminal + exact marker restoration
method.percentiles: nearest rank; success and all outcomes reported separately
method.resource_peaks: sampled, not guaranteed high-water marks; host generator excluded
method.replicas_seen: cumulative container identities, not concurrent replica count; use wave.configuration
method.queue_peak_aggregation: per replica, independent peaks must not be summed as simultaneous
method.retry_control: one bounded client retry; all counts include attempts, not unique users

restoration_audit.original_running_state_note: before snapshot captured after intentional stop; original healthy state independently observed
